description: This file defines a Timer class for managing millisecond timers based on pthreads, including exception handling, message queue management, and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: TimerException
classes.description: Exception class for timer-related errors, derived from std::exception.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class representing a millisecond timer using pthreads, with methods to arm, cancel, and handle timer messages.

classes.name: Timer::TimerMessage
classes.description: Nested class representing messages for timer thread communication, including types for arm, cancel, and quit.

methods.name: Timer::Timer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timer with callback, user data, and name.

methods.name: Timer::~Timer
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up timer resources.

methods.name: Timer::cancel
methods.description: Cancels the active timer, preventing callback invocation.

methods.name: Timer::arm
methods.description: Arms the timer for a specified timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: Timer::TimerMessage::createArmMessage
methods.description: Creates a new message to arm the timer with a specified timeout.

methods.name: Timer::TimerMessage::createCancelMessage
methods.description: Creates a new message to cancel the timer.

methods.name: Timer::TimerMessage::createQuitMessage
methods.description: Creates a new message to signal the timer thread to quit.

methods.name: Timer::timerThreadFunction
methods.description: Static function run by the timer thread to process messages.

methods.name: Timer::timerThread
methods.description: Main loop of the timer thread handling message queue.

methods.name: Timer::postTimerMessage
methods.description: Posts a message to the timer thread's message queue, optionally urgent.
